title: Chapter 260: Thrilling Offensive And Defensive Battle
content:
Chapter 260: Thrilling Offensive And Defensive Battle

Wu Qing was not nervous about the situation of the Zerg army, but many observers from various forces in the local camp became nervous.

"The Zerg army is in danger now!"

"It seems that no one is willing to help!"

"At the last moment, let's see if the goblins will intervene!"

"Alas! Those who want to join the battle don't have the strength, and they can't even rush! Those who have the strength to join the battle choose not to come!"

"This may also be a test! If the Zerg can't even withstand such an attack, they don't deserve to have the status of a great tribe!"

"It's definitely not that easy to fight for the status of a great tribe just after entering the world!"

"The Zerg hasn't lost yet! Their troops can be upgraded at any time. As long as they can upgrade more five-star troops, they may be able to turn defeat into victory!"

"The Zerg army has suffered very little losses now, and there are still a few powerful The troops did not participate in the battle. I think they still have some spare strength. They must have other ideas! "

"The aliens know that the Zerg army still has spare strength. Now they are just fighting a war of attrition and have not used their full strength yet!"

"The Zerg army dares to go deep alone. They must have something to rely on. Let's wait and see what happens!"

"The Zerg army's defense line is very dangerous. If the defense line is breached, there will be a melee. The Zerg army has too few troops and will suffer a lot!"

"Even if there is a trump card, it's almost time to use it now!"

"..."

Wu Qing has been hiding his troops and not moving them. It's not a superficial show of force, but he wants to attract as many alien troops as possible.

Consume more alien troops in this area. After this battle, the Zerg can take the initiative and no longer be calculated and passively beaten.

The Zerg can take the initiative to attack and find trouble with others as needed.

Of course, the most important purpose is to save more resources.

Wu Qing saw that the space transmission channel of the alien race had stopped working. It might be that the alien race felt that the existing forces were enough to defeat the Zerg army.

In order to break the naive idea of the alien race and let them continue to send troops, Wu Qing sent out two hundred five-star Zerg explosive mosquitoes at once.

"Boom...!"

The violent explosions at different locations shook the entire battlefield!

The two hundred explosion points that were accurately calculated by the Queen of the Zerg were attacked by two hundred five-star Zerg explosive mosquitoes at the same time. These explosion points were all the positions where the alien army had the most troops and the most important arms!

The self-explosion power of the five-star Zerg self-explosive mosquitoes was comparable to the full-strength attack of a strong man, and the killing effect was extremely terrifying. The most fiercely attacking alien army in front of the Zerg army's defense line disappeared instantly!

This greatly relieved the defensive pressure of the Zerg army.

Wu Qing took advantage of this gap and selected five thousand Zerg destroyers to increase their strength to five stars.

The Zerg army once again increased its strength on the battlefield!

When tens of thousands of five-star Zerg destroyers opened fire together, the elite troops of the alien race, which were originally difficult to defeat, disappeared one by one, suffering heavy losses!

The Zerg army consumed two hundred five-star Zerg explosive mosquitoes and increased the number of five-star Zerg destroyers. The alien race believed that the Zerg army's trump card had been used, and the time for a full-scale attack had finally arrived!

Hundreds of thousands of cavalry units of the alien race, and a large number of cavalry units of various affiliated races of the alien race, simultaneously launched a high-speed charge against the Zerg army!

The various air forces of the alien army, which had been eyeing the sky, also rushed towards the Zerg army at the same time!

The alien army launched a three-dimensional offensive, and the intensity of the attack instantly increased by several levels!

"Boom boom boom...!"

Ten thousand five-star Zerg destroyers, under the control of the queen, opened fire at full speed and attacked the high-speed charging alien cavalry with the best efficiency!

All five hundred Zerg queens took action, releasing traps to limit the speed of the charge of the cavalry units of the alien race!

More than 400,000 Zerg Hydralisks, most of their firepower turned to air defense, and attacked the flying units of the alien race flying at high speed!

150,000 Zerg Dragons, regardless of casualties, rushed to the flying units of the alien race, relying on their own stronger strength to fight the enemy head-on in the air!

A fierce melee began!

The flying units of the alien army participated in the battle, not only dragging the Zerg Dragon group into a tragic war of attrition, but also tied down the firepower of more than half of the Zerg Hydralisks.

This made the long-range attack units in the alien army lose their suppression, and launched a more fierce long-range attack on the Zerg army.

The Zerg Queen's trapping net cooperated with the Zerg Destroyer's attack to suppress the fierce charge of most of the alien cavalry units, but some cavalry units still rushed to the front of the Zerg army!

The armor-piercing spikes of the Zerg Stealth Spiders began to focus fire on the cavalry units that entered the range, and cooperated with the limited Zerg Hydralisks and Zerg Roaches to block the impact of the alien cavalry.

Several particularly powerful alien cavalry units broke through the layers of defense of the Zerg army and rushed into the Zerg army's formation with a single charge!

This made the people from all parties watching the battle nervous!

"Is the defense line going to be broken!?"

"All arms of the Zerg army have taken action, but they still can't change the situation!"

"The aliens are well prepared, and this offensive is too fierce!"

"The Zerg army is strong, but it has too few soldiers! Even if there were more ordinary soldiers to make up the numbers, this battle would not have ended like this!"

"..."

It seems that the defeat of the Zerg army has become a foregone conclusion.

The 100,000 three-star Zerg puppies in the Zerg army, who have never really fought, rushed towards the charging alien cavalry at this time, showing their strength as close combat killing machines!

The alien cavalry troops, which are generally one-star in strength, can only be slaughtered when facing three-star Zerg puppies.

The Zerg puppies have brought their killing skills to the extreme. Every part of their body is a weapon for killing. With an absolute advantage in strength, they quickly wiped out the alien cavalry troops that rushed to the front.

On the battlefield, most of the Zerg destroyers and some Zerg hydralisks entered the upgraded pupation state again.

"I didn't expect the Zerg's melee troops to be so strong! They are simply born for killing!"

"The cavalry has no advantage in front of them!"

"The Zerg army's long-range troops have started to upgrade again!"

"..."

Wu Qing upgraded all the two-star Zerg destroyers, a small number of which were upgraded to four-star, and the rest were upgraded to three-star.

The Zerg Hydralisk is also in this mode, with a small number of four-star and a large number of three-star, continuing to strengthen its air and long-range attack capabilities.

After they were upgraded, the Zerg stealth spiders also stopped attacking and crawled to the ground for upgrading. Wu Qing upgraded all 40,000 one-star Zerg stealth spiders to three-star.

The attack power of the Zerg stealth spiders is very considerable. The mode of sneaking underground to attack prevents the enemy from attacking them. They also have a restraining effect on various cavalry units, which is very suitable for the current battlefield.

50,000 Zerg stealth spiders of three stars or above are a terrible defensive force.

The Zerg army has completed this round of upgrades. The attacks on the flying alien soldiers who are fighting with the Zerg dragons in the air and the cavalry troops who are blocked by the Zerg Queen's trap net have increased exponentially in an instant.

A large number of flying alien soldiers fell and turned into light. The cavalry troops who were charging hard and the long-range soldiers who were attacking fiercely were hit hard in turn, and the troops were rapidly decreasing!

Zerg dragons, Zerg hydralisks, Zerg cockroaches and Zerg puppies all suffered casualties, and the combat strength of the Zerg army was constantly decreasing.

The Zerg army paid a price, but successfully defended the defense line under the most fierce offensive of the alien army.

If the Zerg army's defense line is stabilized, it can use the ultra-long range of the Zerg destroyer to quickly consume the troops of the alien army.

However, the alien army can do nothing about this, and there is no corresponding army to suppress the attack of the Zerg destroyer.

The 50,000 Zerg destroyers, after all being upgraded, have greatly increased their killing efficiency and are back to their best condition. If they continue to fight like this, no matter how many troops the alien army has, they will eventually be blown up by them.

The Zerg Queen's trapping net can greatly limit the speed of the cavalry. On such a battlefield, as long as the cavalry charging in front is caught, the momentum of the entire cavalry will be broken.

The cavalry is surrounded by dense infantry. They can't even charge around. They can only be blocked in an awkward position and endure the firepower attack of the Zerg army.

In order to make room for the cavalry to charge, the infantry of the aliens has reduced the input of troops and weakened the offensive. The Zerg army, which has increased its strength again, is enough to deal with it.

The entire battle seems to have reached a stalemate again.

"The Zerg army's operation has stabilized the defense line! As long as they hold on, they may be able to turn the tables!"

"As soon as the aliens stopped investing more troops, something went wrong on the battlefield here. This is forcing them to increase their investment!"

"I don't know if this is a coincidence or intentional!"

"This Zerg is really surprising. The outcome of this war is unpredictable. I hope the Zerg can continue this momentum and give everyone a surprise!"

"It's really exciting!"

"..."

Many spectators have regained their confidence in the Zerg from the performance of the Zerg army.

With the heavy losses of the air and cavalry forces of the aliens, they can't sit still.

The space transmission channel built by the aliens in the 66th city started working again, and a large number of the aliens' own troops were teleported over.

This time, the teleported troops did not immediately walk out of the light attribute energy shield. Among them, hundreds of human mages wearing wizard robes and holding magic wands cast magic together under layers of guard.
